name: journals_by_type_with_reconcile_model_count
source_sql: SELECT j.id, j.code, j.type, j.company_id, j.currency_id, j.default_account_id, j.active, j.name->>'en_US' AS name, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_journal_account_reconcile_model_rel r WHERE r.account_journal_id = j.id) AS reconcile_model_count FROM account_journal j

name: dashboard_journals_per_company_and_type
source_sql: SELECT company_id, type, count(*) AS journals, count(*) FILTER (WHERE show_on_dashboard) AS on_dashboard FROM account_journal GROUP BY company_id, type

name: payment_method_lines_per_journal
source_sql: SELECT l.id, l.journal_id, l.payment_method_id, m.code, m.payment_type, l.sequence, l.payment_account_id FROM account_payment_method_line l JOIN account_payment_method m ON m.id = l.payment_method_id

name: reconcile_models_with_line_and_partner_counts
source_sql: SELECT r.id, r.name->>'en_US' AS name, r.rule_type, r.company_id, r.sequence, r.active, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_reconcile_model_line l WHERE l.model_id = r.id) AS line_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_reconcile_model_res_partner_rel p WHERE p.account_reconcile_model_id = r.id) AS partner_count FROM account_reconcile_model r

name: reconcile_model_line_taxes
source_sql: SELECT t.account_reconcile_model_line_id, t.account_tax_id, l.model_id FROM account_reconcile_model_line_account_tax_rel t JOIN account_reconcile_model_line l ON l.id = t.account_reconcile_model_line_id
